overview_description.description: Codag provides developer tools that compress infrastructure log data into compact, structured text that AI agents can process. The platform groups similar log lines into templates, ranks patterns, and preserves surrounding context with references to real line numbers. Codag offers a hosted service, CLI, SDKs, and MCP integrations that sit in front of large language model agents. Developers can wrap existing log commands so that agents receive compact text instead of raw log streams. The system supports line-oriented formats such as JSON logs, syslog, Kubernetes logs, and other application logs with preprocessing and redaction. Codag is used to help agents debug distributed systems by turning high-volume logs into cited evidence within token limits.

product.name: Codag Pro
product.description: Codag Pro is a hosted service that compresses large infrastructure log windows into compact, cited text for use by AI agents.

product.name: Codag Free
product.description: Codag Free is an open-source and hosted deterministic log compaction path based on codag-drain for smaller or low-cost workloads.

product.name: codag-drain
product.description: codag-drain is an open-source Rust log templating engine that groups raw log lines into deterministic template clusters.

product.name: codag-cli
product.description: codag-cli is an open-source Go command-line client and MCP server that wraps log commands and sends them to Codag for compaction.

product.name: codag-visualizer
product.description: codag-visualizer is a VS Code extension that displays AI workflows as live diagrams linked to source code.
